metadata.name: lana cool places seed (Basel-Stadt)
metadata.description: Hand-curated publicly accessible cool places for hot days. Addresses geocoded ONCE with Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) during spec exploration - never geocoded at runtime.
sources: https://www.bs.ch/themen/gesundheit/gesundheitsfoerderung/praeventionsangebote/hitze (official cantonal list of publicly accessible cool rooms, section 'Öffentlich zugängliche Räumlichkeiten')
Well-known Basel museums, libraries and churches added as supplements
metadata.geocoding: Nominatim https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search (format=jsonv2, limit=1), one request per address with custom User-Agent and >=1s delay; see cool-places-notes.md for per-place confidence

properties.name: Kunstmuseum Basel Hauptbau
properties.note: Ticket-free zones (foyer, Hofumgang, Eventfoyer) stay below 25 °C on hot days

properties.name: Novartis Pavillon
properties.note: Open foyer with coffee corner (no purchase obligation) and free SchoolHub; Tue–Fri 08–18, Sat/Sun 10–18

properties.name: Öffentliche Plaza im k Haus
properties.note: Public plaza open daily 09:00–21:00, no purchase obligation

properties.name: Foyer Public, Theater Basel
properties.note: Public theatre foyer Tue–Sun 11:00–18:00, no purchase obligation (seasonal closures possible)

properties.name: Unternehmen Mitte
properties.note: Café/work space without purchase obligation, drinking water station

properties.name: Markthalle «Wohnzimmer»
properties.note: 450 m² 'living room' with sofas and tables, no purchase obligation; late opening hours

properties.name: Park im Claraspital
properties.note: Shady hospital park with deck chairs, benches and a barefoot path, open to the public

properties.name: Matthäuskirche
properties.note: Sonntagszimmer: free soup/coffee Sundays in the naturally cool basement; open church Tue afternoons

properties.name: Theodorskirche
properties.note: TheoBar open meeting Wed 12:00–18:00 in the pleasantly cool church, free quarter lunch table

properties.name: GGG Stadtbibliothek Schmiedenhof
properties.note: City-centre library; officially recommended as relatively cool (lower floors), no purchase obligation

properties.name: GGG Stadtbibliothek St. Johann JUKIBU
properties.note: Library in St. Johann; officially recommended as one of the relatively cool branches

properties.name: GGG Stadtbibliothek Breite
properties.note: Library in Breite; officially recommended as one of the relatively cool branches

properties.name: Universitätsbibliothek Basel
properties.note: Public university library with reading rooms, open to everyone

properties.name: Basler Münster
properties.note: Romanesque/Gothic cathedral, naturally cool thick sandstone, free entry

properties.name: Elisabethenkirche
properties.note: Open city church next to the theatre, cool interior, community café at times

properties.name: Museum Tinguely
properties.note: Air-conditioned museum on the Rhine (ticket required for exhibitions)

properties.name: Naturhistorisches Museum Basel
properties.note: Natural history museum in a thick-walled 19th-century building, cool interior (ticket)

properties.name: Museum der Kulturen Basel
properties.note: Museum on the Münster hill, cool interior (ticket)

properties.name: Antikenmuseum Basel
properties.note: Antiquity museum in the shade of St. Alban, cool interior (ticket)

properties.name: Historisches Museum Barfüsserkirche
properties.note: History museum inside a former Gothic church, naturally cool stone interior (ticket)
